name: black-friday-launcher
description: Helps you get your Black Friday sale ready, with your sales page, order form, special offers, thank-you page and launch emails, all as drafts for you to look over first. Operator detail, not for the client: composes the separate page skills into one runtime walk for the buyer: validated intake, build-time page generation kept separate from buyer-time navigation, the canonical verified-payment route graph (U1 after the original purchase, D1 only on an explicit U1 decline, U2 only after a verified U1 or D1 purchase), a fail-closed entitlement attestation gate (Brand Management membership qualifies without a purchase; School of AI alone does not qualify; ZHC only with Brand Management), Council advice recorded in launch planning and never blocking, and native Convert and Flow checkout bound by contract and never a dispatch adapter. Verified offer facts only: a defaulted price, level or entitlement fails the build. Cross-sales is carried as an offer relationship on the thank-you page with teaching content marked pending. Registered as number 83 (number_final=true) and enabled in 999 (enabled_in_999=true) once its dependency package is satisfied; the folded_levels shape routes and assembles but is delivery-blocked until Skill 79 names a checkout mode.
intent_triggers: run the launcher for my launch
compose my upsell and downsell pages
